description: List email messages for the connected account, with optional filters. Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/messages.

grant_id.description: Connected-account grant id. Overrides NYLAS_GRANT_ID for this call.

page_token.description: Pagination cursor (next_cursor from a prior page).

starred.description: If set, filter by starred status.

unread.description: If set, filter by unread status.

name: nylas_list_messages
title: List messages
